header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2022 and was lastly fixed in the court on 17.11.2022, where order for issuance of notices were made; however since then the notices have not been issued as the petitioner has not come forward for the issuance of notices.

Today, since none has appeared on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation received, it appears that petitioner and his counsel are not interested to pursue this petition; therefore this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
